prompt: Which version of Mozilla Firefox was released with this patch note: "Smooth pinch-zooming using a touchpad is now supported on Linux"?
answer: The patch note was introduced in **Mozilla Firefox 88**, released on **April 19, 2021**. It added smooth touchpad pinch-zooming support on Linux under **Wayland**.
